title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
description: Microsoft released a large Patch Tuesday update addressing 1,093 vulnerabilities, including 63 critical flaws affecting Windows and related software. Among these is a zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-124194) in Microsoft Outlook that is actively exploited. Nearly half of the critical bugs allow remote code execution, and many others enable privilege escalation. Other major vendors including Apple, Google, Mozilla, and Adobe also issued security updates this week. Microsoft credits AI advancements for the increased volume of identified and fixed vulnerabilities. The update is part of a continuous effort to mitigate risks from vulnerabilities actively exploited or potentially exploitable in the wild.
